prompt: Vitrine site bar shown at the top of every museum page: wordmark, main navigation, compact collection search and the account slot.
shortDesc: Site bar: put it first on EVERY page, always as <g-site-header current="…"><google-login slot="account"></google-login></g-site-header> (the header has no login of its own; google-login needs no attributes; its default label is fine). Wrap everything after it in <main id="main"> and end the page with <g-site-footer></g-site-footer>. It has the wordmark, the nav links Highlights, Collections and My exhibitions, and a compact search, so don't add another search to the header. current is one of highlights | collections | exhibitions | home | search (artwork, artist and collection pages use collections). SITE ROUTES and the component that gives each page its h1: / → g-feature-hero · /search/<query> → g-page-section level="1" + g-artwork-grid search · /search (or /search/) with no query (linked from the header on phones and from the footer) → g-page-section level="1" heading="Search the collections" holding g-search-box and g-theme-chips themes="…" base="search", with no g-artwork-grid · /artwork/<id> → g-artwork-view · /artist/<name> → g-artist-profile · /collections → g-page-section level="1" + g-collection-list · /collections/<collection id> → g-feature-hero collection · /highlights and /highlights/<theme> → g-feature-hero · /exhibitions → g-page-section level="1" + g-exhibition-list · /exhibitions/new and /exhibitions/new/<artwork id> → g-page-section level="1" + g-exhibition-form · /exhibitions/<exhibition id> → g-exhibition-view alone (exhibition ids are never 'new'). Singular /collection/<id> and /exhibition/<id> are the same pages as the plural ones. Pass URL segments to attributes with percent-escapes decoded (%20 → space).

props.name: current
props.description: Nav section to mark: highlights, collections or exhibitions. Artwork, artist and collection pages use collections. On home and search pages write home or search (no link is marked). Examples: current="highlights" on /highlights/the%20sea, current="collections" on /artwork/aic-16568, current="exhibitions" on /exhibitions/new.

props.name: site-name
props.description: Wordmark text. Default "Vitrine"; normally leave it out.

slots.name: account
slots.description: Right-hand account area. Always fill it.

slots.name: nav
slots.description: Replaces the default links (rarely needed). Mark the current one with aria-current="page".

styling.tailwindClasses: flex items-center gap-9 min-h-16 px-8 bg-white border-b border-stone-200 font-serif text-stone-900
styling.notes: VITRINE kit. A quiet 64px bar on --paper with a 1px --rule bottom border; content aligned to the 1240px page column. Wordmark in Newsreader 500 24px preceded by an 8px oxblood square with a faint gilt halo, like a label pin. Nav in Instrument Sans 500 14px, 28px apart; the current link is oxblood with a 2px oxblood underline offset 6px and aria-current="page". The search is a 44px field on --wall with a hairline border, 200px growing to 260px on focus, an oxblood ring while focused and a magnifier submit button. Between 760 and 980px everything tightens (20px gaps, field 150px growing to 180px). Below 760px the nav becomes a scrollable second row under a hairline (right edge fades while it overflows) and the search collapses to a magnifier that expands inline across the bar with a close button (Escape closes). Focus rings on the phone nav row are drawn inset so the scroller does not clip them. Skip link to #main appears on keyboard focus. All hit targets 44px; transitions off under prefers-reduced-motion.

dependencies.usage: Built-in sign-in control placed by the page in slot="account".
